title: PinPlay
blurb: Join a live class quiz with a PIN, or work through an assignment your teacher shared.

title: Watchword
blurb: One-word clues, one shared device, and a race to guess as many secret words as you can.

title: Password: Alphabet Race
blurb: Hear a clue and find one word for every letter of the alphabet before time runs out.

title: Impostor
blurb: Everyone sees the same secret word — except the impostor, who has to blend in.

title: Dictation Time
blurb: Listen to a sentence, type what you hear, and compare your answer word by word.

title: Read · Listen · Speak
blurb: Read short sentences aloud and see which words your browser recognised. Microphone needed.

title: Babble Bazaar
blurb: Listen to a customer's order, find or prepare the items, and hand them over.

title: Snakes & Ladders
blurb: Roll, move, and take on a speaking, translation, or grammar challenge on every square.

title: ESL Grammar Studio
blurb: Browse grammar points by level, read a plain explanation, and try focused practice.

title: Irregular Verb Coach
blurb: Build a study set of irregular verbs, hear them, and quiz yourself until they stick.

title: Prepositions Practice
blurb: Review how English prepositions work, then practise with three kinds of exercise.

title: General American Phonetics
blurb: Tap through the American English sound charts and hear each sound in example words.

title: Number Mania
blurb: Answer arithmetic aloud or on the keypad and climb a ladder that adapts to you.

title: English Hub
blurb: The class portal for 3rd and 4th ESO. An authorised school Google account is required.

title: WordMine
blurb: Hear an instruction, look around a calm 3D room, and act on what you understood.

title: Go2Town
blurb: Follow Coco the seagull through Coma-ruga on short spoken walking missions.
